mailbox_screening.method: Read-only keyword screening; relevant decoded plain-text and HTML messages reviewed with source dates, identifiers and private archive offsets.

gmail_separate_nyesta_pass.note: Overlaps with broader discovery results; do not add these as independent unique totals.

limitations: Screening is keyword-based, followed by review of relevant candidates; it is not a full semantic reading of every message.
Oversized mbox messages were screened within a 16 MiB prefix, and retained candidate text was capped at 90,000 characters. Attachment contents were not systematically searched.
The main Lamont/drone/teaching Gmail query was paged to the end. Broader teaching searches reached a five-page bound; the entire Gmail account is not claimed as exhaustively reviewed.
Monthly archive files describe the locally available mail, not proof of a complete server archive or exact event dates.
Activity records describe instruction and operations, not unique flights, verified attendance totals, measured learning gains or independently validated survey accuracy.
